pricing_snapshot.note: Prices frozen at run time. Every derived cost in this receipt is computed from THIS snapshot, never from the live registry, so the receipt keeps its meaning when registry prices later change.

cases.reason: Meets criteria 1 (targets validation) and 2 (names the ValidateOrder forwarder); criterion 3 is missed since it never says whether removal concentrates or moves complexity, and criterion 4 is only partly met.

Prioritizes the validation area and identifies the ValidateOrder forwarding layer, and explains that removal concentrates rule logic behind one interface. It never describes a public test seam or why it would survive the change.

Uses the Reservation term, identifies the accepted ADR conflict, and avoids the broad merge for fewer modules. It misses the evidence-before-reopening criterion, since it says the ADR shouldn't be reopened rather than requiring evidence first.

Met criteria 1 (uses Reservation term) and 2 (identifies conflict with accepted ADR). Missed criterion 3: it does not require evidence before reopening the decision, instead only suggesting superseding the ADR explicitly. Met criterion 4: it avoids proposing a broad merge.

Meets criteria 1 (names ShippingFacade, CarrierClient, pass-through friction) and 4 (asks user to pick A, B, or C). Misses 2, since no concrete smaller interface is proposed, and 3, since the before/after relationship is only implied.

Names ShippingFacade and CarrierClient with concrete friction (duplicated surface, matching edits) and proposes a task-oriented interface, and asks the user to choose a direction. Misses an explicit before/after relationship.

aggregates.band_rule: per arm: the sample standard deviation (n-1) of the per-case means across the included cases; the comparison band is the quadrature sum of the two arms; null where an arm has fewer than two included cases

judge_overhead.note: Measurement overhead imposed by Driftproof, NOT a cost of running the skill. Excluded from every field above. Counted over every draw sent to the judge, each once: the usage its answered judge samples reported, including parse retries, at the frozen judge price. Transport retries and samples that reported no usage are not in it.

notes.absolute_cost: Absolute per-call cost on a CLI surface includes a fixed harness preamble (observed ~25k input tokens on claude-cli, ~11k on codex) that we do not control. It is identical in the with-skill and baseline arms, so it cancels in the Δ figures — read the incremental columns, not the absolute ones.
notes.cache_pricing: Cached input tokens are costed at the list input rate (an over-estimate where caching is heavy); cached_tokens is recorded per call so a reader can recompute.
notes.latency: observed on subscription CLI surface, indicative
